summary: the disk write cases of tests/run parts on i686, the recovery shell's `disk write` at GUID and MBR disks, against a recovery kernel that writes a disk with a GUID header, one that does not read the last sector, and one that does not look at the MBR's entries

argv: ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2-recovery && ARCH=i686 sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2-recovery/kernel

faults.name: refusal-removed
faults.summary: the refusal of a disk with a GUID header taken out, so that the command writes the backup header of a disk without a protective MBR and answers the MBR's refusal on one with it

faults.name: backup-unread
faults.summary: the read of the last sector taken out, so that a disk whose LBA 1 says nothing is taken for one without a table

faults.name: mbr-unread
faults.summary: the check of the MBR's entries taken out, so that a partition reaching the last sector is not seen
